explanation.perfectText: = ranking places 1-4 in the group in the exact order they finished the group stage
explanation.minorMistakeText: = a swap between adjacent places (one mistake between places 1,2 or 2,3 or 3,4)

explanation.line1: You can set the points awarded for each match in the group stage and the knockout stage
explanation.line2: First the 1X2 prediction on the match result (90 min) is calculated
explanation.line3: Then a bonus is given for hitting the exact result (90 min)
explanation.line4: In the knockout stages you can add a bonus for predicting the qualifier to the next round
explanation.line5: You can add an extra bonus for the semi-final and final matches

explanation.line1: Each user must pick 2 teams (winner and runner-up)
explanation.line2: You can set bonus points for each stage these teams advance to, and a bonus for winning the tournament.

explanation.line1: You can choose which special questions are included in the tournament
explanation.line2: You can choose 0 points to disable a specific prediction

explanation.line1: The player who finished the tournament with the most assists
explanation.line2: You can set bonus points for each assist the player made
explanation.line3: A "winning the title" bonus is awarded to the player(s) who finished the tournament with the most assists

explanation.line1: Each participant must pick one player as the top scorer
explanation.line2: You can set bonus points for each goal the player scored
explanation.line3: A "winning the title" bonus is awarded to the player(s) who finished the tournament with the most goals
